title: Basin-lake mass-breeder foundational body plan
scope: Foundational family-grade body plan and ordinary Mana-use boundary for the first mass-breeding aquatic migrant established by WLD-ECOLOGY-006; usable within shared-setting ecology, seasonal planning, organism design, and story development.
claims: The mass-breeding migrant belongs to a fully aquatic alien biological lineage.
Its established migratory form has a streamlined, laterally flexible trunk supported by springy cartilage.
Three pairs of fin-fans (six fin-fans) and a strong muscular tail form its visible locomotor foundation.
A wedge-shaped mineralised head shield forms the front of the body.
Its aquatic respiratory surfaces form folds that may be exposed or held in a more protected configuration and support active aquatic respiration.
Mana contributes to ordinary tissue reinforcement as part of its physiology rather than creating a specialised activated ability.
WLD-ECOLOGY-006 continues to govern its egg-ribbon deposition, adult return and mortality, predation, recruitment, and population variability.
boundaries: Foundational body plan describes a shared structural template; it establishes no formal taxonomic rank, one species, invariant morphology, or number and range of related organisms.
The descriptive terms establish no fish, shark, vertebrate, gill, fin-ray, jaw, limb, or caudal-fin homology and no direct Earth-animal transplant.
Fully aquatic establishes no terrestrial locomotion, nesting, air breathing, leaping, crawling, or overland bypass and does not define stranding tolerance.
Compatibility with migration does not prove outlet passability, route depth, speed, endurance, homing, salinity immunity, or guaranteed return.
Exact size, proportions, colour, skin, sexual variation, juvenile morphology, and change across life stages remain undefined.
Support-lattice microstructure, segmentation, stiffness, fatigue, repair, and propulsion gait remain undefined.
Fin-fan positions, shapes, folding, actuation, specialisation, damage tolerance, and exact functions remain undefined; the three pairs establish no Earth-fin homology.
Tail profile, terminal structures, movement, burst performance, and sustained performance remain undefined.

Shield composition, thickness, growth, attachment, repair, openings, sensory role, and ecological function remain undefined; no ramming, digging, feeding, egg-placement, or armour-immunity function is established.
Respiratory-fold position, structure, ventilation, circulation, exchange capacity, protection, and life-stage variation remain undefined.

WLD-ECOLOGY-008 establishes dedicated ion-exchange organs and longitudinally distributed wax-like-gel chambers as the established migratory form's foundational osmoregulatory and passive-buoyancy strategy. Exact organ anatomy, transport chemistry, acclimation performance, chamber geometry and material, quantitative density and trim, hydrodynamic correction, and life-stage variation remain undefined.
Diet, digestion, senses, navigation, schooling, rest, daily timing, fertilisation, reproductive anatomy, release posture, and egg attendance remain undefined.
Mana source, access, carrier, storage, circulation, tissue targets, capacity, metabolic coupling, cost, recovery, and failure remain undefined.

Mana-supported tissue reinforcement is not CAL0 level reinforcement, a buff, invulnerability, instant repair, free energy, a spell, Skill, class, aura, reward, specialised activated ability, or universal rule for all fauna.
Cognition, sapience, formal Skills, classes, levels, appraisal, and human or character knowledge remain undefined.
Egg ribbons describe egg arrangement only and establish no ribbon-shaped adult or relationship to Lineage II ribbon forms.

WLD-ECOLOGY-009 separately governs the family-care migrant's foundational body plan and shelter–forage–regroup care interface; it establishes no shared anatomy, ancestry, physiology, or Mana pathway with the mass breeder.
Food, oxygen, minerals, energy, recovery, heat and waste handling, disease, parasites, injury, predation, route capacity, reproduction, and carrying capacity remain binding ecological constraints.
story_implications: An observable encounter can use the animal's flexible swimming silhouette, six fin-fans, muscular tail, leading shield, and changing respiratory exposure.
Structure and movement can be observed before their functions, internal anatomy, Mana pathways, migration physiology, or taxonomy are known.
Author-side knowledge of the full body plan does not become automatic protagonist knowledge; each inference requires a source and bounded confidence.
system_implications: The selected morphology and physiological Mana contribution are world inputs under CAL0 WLD1.1D, WLD1.2D, and WLD2.1A+D, not a System change.
Ordinary Mana-supported tissue function remains distinct from earned CAL0 reinforcement and requires a later causal source, carrier, capacity, cost, recovery, and failure pathway.
The body plan creates no universal creature level, pooled identity, retrospective XP, automatic reward, spawn mechanism, refill, or power transfer.
research_questions: What size, body proportions, stiffness distribution, swimming gait, and route energetics make the freshwater-sea migration viable?
Where are the three fin-fan pairs positioned, how do they fold or actuate, and how are control functions divided among them?

What tail profile, chamber geometry, gel properties, buoyant-support distribution, quantitative trim, and active hydrodynamic correction elaborate the WLD-ECOLOGY-008 strategy around the mineralised anterior shield?
What is the head shield made from, how does it grow and repair, and what ecological functions does it actually perform?
How are respiratory folds ventilated and protected from drag, silt, parasites, injury, variable oxygen, and osmotic exposure?
How do the selected ion-exchange organs operate in the established migratory form, and what separate water-and-ion strategies govern eggs and juveniles?
What source, carrier, circulation, tissue targets, capacity, cost, recovery, and failure modes make ordinary Mana-supported tissue reinforcement causal?
How do juvenile morphology, maturation, reproduction, diet, senses, navigation, behaviour, related species, and human knowledge elaborate this foundation?

author_approval.evidence: After the fully aquatic flexible fin-fan body-plan package was presented, the Author replied 'yes' to 'Should this become the mass-spawner’s foundational body plan?' on 2026-08-14.
